releases.name: v0.2.0a6 — repo catches up to PyPI; colleague-ready README
releases.body:
## 0.2.0a5 / 0.2.0a6 — 2026-09-24

The release line catches up to PyPI: `pip install zft` now serves 0.2.0a6, and this export brings the repository to the same point.

**0.2.0a5 — colleague-readiness**, verified by a fresh `git clone` over HTTPS plus `pip install zft` on four machines (no credentials, clean venvs): lint reports 43 clause nodes, `zft check` exits 0 against the shipped baseline, attest + verify green.

- The seed contract is **43 validated clause nodes**, not 26 (the count now cites `zft lint` as its source).
- The opencode gates install from npm — `bun add -D opencode-zft`, add `"opencode-zft"` to your `opencode.json` — as well as by copying the sources.
- The changelog and `docs/` artifacts are linked from the README.

**0.2.0a6** — version alignment with the npm package (`opencode-zft@0.2.0-alpha.6`), which is published with the `latest` and `alpha` tags both current.

**Install:** `pip install zft` · `bun add -D opencode-zft`

releases.name: v0.2.0a4 — PyPI page renders, doc references fixed
releases.body:
## 0.2.0a4 — 2026-09-23

Documentation and packaging completeness release.

**0.2.0a3 was functional but its PyPI page rendered empty** — the `readme` key had been fixed in the cut repo only and was lost when the a3 export re-derived `pyproject.toml` from the lab. The fix now lives in the lab, so it travels with every export.

- **PyPI page renders** — `readme = "README.md"` plus `[project.urls]` (homepage, repository, issues, changelog) and topic classifiers.
- **No shipped doc points at a non-shipped doc** — two `designs/` pages referenced `docs/PUBLIC_REPO.md` (internal publish machinery); the Codex plugin README's `HB-3` reference now names what it means.
- **npm `opencode-zft@0.2.0-alpha.4`** published, version-aligned with the CLI.

**Install:** `pip install zft==0.2.0a4` · `bun add -D opencode-zft@alpha`

releases.name: v0.2.0a3 — six first-try fixes
releases.body:
## 0.2.0a3 — 2026-09-23

Six first-try defects found by installing the 0.2.0a2 wheel into a fresh pipx/venv and running the README quickstart verbatim (consumer path, no repo checkout). All fixed test-first:

- **`zft attest` on any non-checkout install** — the gate-manifest hash walk assumed the repo's `src/` layout and looked for `<env>/lib/python3.12/src/zft/...`. Manifests now record package-relative keys, identical in every install layout.
- **Typed `zft negotiate` refusal** — a store without a contract manifest raised a raw traceback at the consumer; now exits 1 with `negotiation refused: ...`.
- **README quickstart `--key-in`** — `zft verify` hard-requires the public key but the quickstart showed a bare invocation, so the first consumer run failed as written.
- **`zft <cmd> --help`** — every subcommand ran on a directory literally named `--help` (and `baseline --help` silently created one). All 14 print usage and exit 0.
- **README as the PyPI long description** — the `readme` key was lost in the rename squash; both artifacts now pass `twine check` clean.
- **Dead `securesystemslib[cryptography]` extra dropped** — securesystemslib 1.5.1 no longer provides it, so every install warned.

Also: `plugins/` (the Codex/ZCode gate hook + skill) and `CHANGELOG.md` now ship, and the export carries a safety gate that hard-fails on anything outside the public set.

**Install:** `pip install zft==0.2.0a3` · wheel `9ebc1a77…` (byte-reproducible)

releases.name: v0.2.0a2 — rename completion + opencode integration
releases.body:
## v0.2.0a2 — rename completion + opencode integration

- The `traceagent`→`zft` rename is complete: the import package is `zft`, the
  sole console script is `zft`, and every environment variable is `ZFT_*` with
  **no legacy `TRACEAGENT_*` fallback** (`ZFT_BIN`, `ZFT_GATE_DISABLED`,
  `ZFT_HOOK_MODE`, `ZFT_ALLOW_UNGATED`, `ZFT_REPO`, …).
- **0.2.0a2 is on PyPI** — `pip install zft`.
- Editor integration now ships: `.opencode/plugins/` (a dispatch gate that
  blocks contract-less subagent work, and an L0 edit gate that re-lints the
  clause store on every edit) plus the `zft` skill; the README installs from
  it. Both are no-ops outside a `.zft/` workspace.
- Reverse-coverage baseline re-seeded on the public tree
  (`.zft/baseline/elements.json`, 2021 elements).

## Verification

- Full test suite green; `ruff` clean; both plugin harnesses 10/10.
- `zft lint .` green — 43 clause nodes. `zft check .` ok: 32 clauses due,
  11 deferred (the v0.1 AI-conduct and ReqIF-import items), 0 failures.
- Wheel byte-reproducible (`SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` pinned).

## Known limitations

- No CI workflow YAML ships, by decision.
- The plugins enforce *traceability*, not conformance — a bound-but-fake test
  (`assert True`) still passes them. See `docs/KNOWN-GAPS.md`, Gap 001.

releases.name: v0.2.0a1 — first public cut
releases.body:
## v0.2.0a1 — first public cut

- Contract-first verification and trace-matrix gates for agent deliverables.
- L0–L3 gate pipeline, invariant DSL, lineage extraction, DSSE
  attestation; seed v0 contract: 32 clause nodes, self-check green (32/32).
- Install: `pip install -e .` (see README). Known gaps: docs/KNOWN-GAPS.md.

## Known limitations

- No CI workflow YAML ships in the public cut (by decision).
- Full suite green as of 2026-09-15: 1048 pass / 0 fail / 7 xfail / 1 skip
  (an L1 oracle-batch collection-boundary bug that had masked six tests was
  found and fixed the same day — see RESEARCH_LOG).
- Full release notes TBC at publish.
